 Order

This is first bail application filed by the applicants under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail apprehending her arrest in relation to FIR/Crime No. 406/2025 registered at Police Station Bameetha District Chhatarpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections U/s 376(2)(n), 376 (d), of I.P.C and Sec 5(1)/ 6 of POCSO, 2012 and Sec 9,10 of Prohibition Of Child Marriage Act.
2. As per the prosecution, the allegations against the applicant is that she knowing that the victim is minor has married with her son.
The applicant is women of 60 years of age and mother-in-law of victim.
After marrying the husband Mukesh and co-accused Hari Kushwaha alleged to have raped the victim.
Hence, applicant deserves to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
3. The counsel for the State has opposed the application for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:49598 2 MCRC-43670-2025 5.
Looking to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, role of the accused/applicant in crime, this Court deems it proper to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.
